title: Integer linear combinations of integer multiplicity currents (Simon 3.2(1))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, U ⊆ ℝ^P open, T₁, T₂ ∈ D_n(U) integer multiplicity, a, b ∈ ℤ, and S ∈ D_n(U) with S(ω) = a·T₁(ω) + b·T₂(ω) for every ω ∈ D^n(U). Then S is integer multiplicity.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)), IsOpen U → ∀ (T₁ T₂ S : GeometricCurrentOn U n) (a b : ℤ), IsIntegerMultiplicity T₁ → IsIntegerMultiplicity T₂ → (∀ ω, S ω = (a : ℝ) * T₁ ω + (b : ℝ) * T₂ ω) → IsIntegerMultiplicity S
